description: This file is a startup script for setting up and managing a MongoDB server, including checks for existing instances, starting the server, creating users, and generating connection info.

methods.name: mongosh
methods.description: MongoDB shell command used for database administration and user management.

methods.name: sudo mongod
methods.description: Command to start the MongoDB server with specified options.

methods.name: pgrep
methods.description: Utility to find process IDs matching criteria.

methods.name: lsof
methods.description: Lists open files, used here to find the port MongoDB is listening on.

methods.name: pkill
methods.description: Kills processes by name, used here to stop mongod.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of seconds.
